summary: PLAT-103-1/2 shipped in PR #1 (merged, CI+CD green): validateApp throws if owner missing/empty; billing passes owner 'payments' (package.json team). Assumptions: shared-contracts is an in-repo lib inlined at build, so no registry release/lockfile change; bumped its version to 2.0.0 (breaking) for the record. Combined lib+billing in one PR so ordering is safe.

PR #2: core-shell passes owner 'platform', reports passes owner 'insights' (from package.json team) to validateApp. Merged, CI+CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts is inlined from libs/ so no dependency bump needed; owner hardcoded to match package.json team. PR #2 was opened before dev-a's PR #1 merged (old contract ignores extra field, so order-safe); verified post-merge main builds with the new owner check.
